title: DinoGame
tagline: You play this game and if you score above certain score then you earn tokens.  You can then use those tokens to buy ad space in the game.  This can give the token some value and incentivise people to play more.
description:
You play this game and if you score above certain score then you earn tokens.

You can then use those tokens to buy ad space in the game.

This can give the token some value and incentivise people to play more.

The smart contract is deployed on Scroll Sepolia testnet. 

The ad space integration is to be implemented later. For now submission of score and getting of the tokens work.
how_its_made:
You play this game and if you score above certain score then you earn tokens.

You can then use those tokens to buy ad space in the game.

This can give the token some value and incentivise people to play more.

The smart contract is deployed on Scroll Sepolia testnet. 

The ad space integration is to be implemented later. For now submission of score and getting of the tokens work.

I have used Scroll, MetaMask, NextJS for this game. 
The smart contract is deployed on Scroll.
Metamask for sign in. 
In future I will use Filecoin for storing of ads.
